number.why: The abstract reports the served composite HR 0.75 (95% CI 0.65–0.86) for empagliflozin versus placebo. The registry confirms all randomised patients and follow-up through planned treatment completion. The registry labels its matching interval 95.04%; this does not invalidate the abstract-provenance 95% interval. The confirmed estimate is an HR, not the packet's nominal RR.

quotes.span: During a median of 16 months, a primary outcome event occurred in 361 of 1863 patients (19.4%) in the empagliflozin group and in 462 of 1867 patients (24.7%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio for cardiovascular death or hospitalization for heart failure, 0.75; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.65 to 0.86; P<0.001).

entry.why: Adult eligibility, reduced ejection fraction, randomisation, double blinding, placebo comparison and the requested composite endpoint are established.

quotes.span: Male or female patient age \>= 18 years at screening. For Japan only: Age \>= 20 years at screening

In this double-blind trial, we randomly assigned 3730 patients with class II, III, or IV heart failure and an ejection fraction of 40% or less to receive empagliflozin (10 mg once daily) or placebo, in addition to recommended therapy. The primary outcome was a composite of cardiovascular death or hospitalization for worsening heart failure.

missed: No omission overturns either verdict. Preserve the source-specific CI level (abstract 95%; registry 95.04%) and the HR scale: confirmation of this reported HR does not establish an RR.
